Subject: Re: Quick intro — security review request

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the recent demo — the team at QuantumLytics wants to move to a security review next week so we can clear the path for procurement. Participants will include our security lead (Rajesh), one of our platform engineers (Anita), and procurement (I'll loop them in below).

Can we lock a 75–90 minute slot for a technical security review + short procurement call? Our preferred windows (PST):
- Wed 8/6 10:00–11:30
- Thu 8/7 14:00–15:30
- Fri 8/8 09:00–10:30

If you need anything beforehand, please share SOC2 scope, network/data-flow diagram, and a brief list of what you store/retain. I attached our security questionnaire (quantumlytics-security-questions.xlsx) — please fill the shaded sections if possible.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Procurement | QuantumLytics

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — security review request

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear windows and the questionnaire. We can absolutely run the session and match the agenda you outlined (technical security + procurement).

Proposed: Wed 8/6 10:00–11:30 PST (90 min) — we will bring:
- Sergio (AE) — agenda, procurement handoff
- Monica Patel (SE) — architecture, data flow, demo of connection patterns
- Ethan Park (Solutions Eng) — SAML, encryption, runtime controls
- Mina Haddad (Security & Compliance) — SOC2 scope, logging, controls and evidence

Pre-reads we will upload by EOD tomorrow: redwood-sec-overview.pdf (high-level controls), qlyt-ds-diagram-v1.png (network/data flow), and a filled version of your questionnaire for the shaded sections. Please confirm if Wed 10:00 works; if not we can switch to Thu 14:00.

Also, quick ask for the session: can Rajesh confirm whether they want us to present a short threat-model for their integration (we can prep a 10–12 minute focused slide set)?

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sec-overview.pdf

Team — quick alignment so the session runs smoothly tomorrow at 10:00 PST if confirmed by Priya:

Agenda (90m):
- 10:00–10:10 Intro + goals (Sergio)
- 10:10–10:30 Architecture & data flow (Monica)
- 10:30–10:50 Auth & encryption (Ethan)
- 10:50–11:10 Controls, SOC2 evidence & logging (Mina)
- 11:10–11:25 Procurement Qs + next steps (Sergio + Priya)
- 11:25–11:30 Wrap / action items

Prep checklist:
- Monica: have the qlyt-ds-diagram-v1.png ready and a 3-slide walk-through of VPC, egress controls, and optional KV cache handling.
- Ethan: bring notes on SAML, token lifespan, and how we handle key rotation. Keep it practical — Rajesh will likely ask for config examples.
- Mina: prepare SOC2 scope slide and 2 example audit logs (we can show masked entries).
- Sergio: I'll send the invite + calendar invite with a short meeting notes doc.

Because QuantumLytics asked for procurement detail, bring the standard order-form template link so I can circulate after the session.

If you can't make any of these slots, flag here now and I'll move things.
